15	export class HistoryDelta extends StoreDelta {
16	  /**
17	   * Apply the delta to the passed elements and appState, does not modify the snapshot.
18	   */
19	  public applyTo(
20	    elements: SceneElementsMap,
21	    appState: AppState,
22	    snapshot: StoreSnapshot,
23	  ): [SceneElementsMap, AppState, boolean] {
24	    const [nextElements, elementsContainVisibleChange] = this.elements.applyTo(
25	      elements,
26	      // used to fallback into local snapshot in case we couldn't apply the delta
27	      // due to a missing (force deleted) elements in the scene
28	      snapshot.elements,
29	      // we don't want to apply the `version` and `versionNonce` properties for history
30	      // as we always need to end up with a new version due to collaboration,
31	      // approaching each undo / redo as a new user action
32	      {
33	        excludedProperties: new Set(["version", "versionNonce"]),
34	      },
35	    );
36	
37	    const [nextAppState, appStateContainsVisibleChange] = this.appState.applyTo(
38	      appState,
39	      nextElements,
40	    );
41	
42	    const appliedVisibleChanges =
43	      elementsContainVisibleChange || appStateContainsVisibleChange;
44	
45	    return [nextElements, nextAppState, appliedVisibleChanges];
46	  }

50	   */

import type {
  ExcalidrawElement,
  OrderedExcalidrawElement,
} from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import type { CaptureUpdateActionType } from "@excalidraw/element";

import type {
  AppClassProperties,
  AppState,
  ExcalidrawProps,
  BinaryFiles,
  UIAppState,
} from "../types";
import type React from "react";

export type ActionSource =
  | "ui"
  | "keyboard"
  | "contextMenu"
  | "api"
  | "commandPalette";

/** if false, the action should be prevented */
export type ActionResult =

      elements?: readonly ExcalidrawElement[] | null;
      appState?: Partial<AppState> | null;
      files?: BinaryFiles | null;
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateActionType;
      replaceFiles?: boolean;
    }
  | false;

type ActionFn<TData = any> = (
  elements: readonly OrderedExcalidrawElement[],
  appState: Readonly<AppState>,
  formData: TData | undefined,
  app: AppClassProperties,
) => ActionResult | Promise<ActionResult>;

export type UpdaterFn = (res: ActionResult) => void;
export type ActionFilterFn = (action: Action) => void;

export type ActionName =

430	const restoreElementWithProperties = <
431	  T extends Required<Omit<ExcalidrawElement, "customData">> & {
432	    customData?: ExcalidrawElement["customData"];
433	    /** @deprecated */
434	    boundElementIds?: readonly ExcalidrawElement["id"][];
435	    /** @deprecated */
436	    strokeSharpness?: StrokeRoundness;
437	  },
438	  K extends Pick<T, keyof Omit<Required<T>, keyof ExcalidrawElement>>,
439	>(
440	  element: T,
441	  extra: Pick<
442	    T,
443	    // This extra Pick<T, keyof K> ensure no excess properties are passed.
444	    // @ts-ignore TS complains here but type checks the call sites fine.
445	    keyof K
446	  > &
447	    Partial<Pick<ExcalidrawElement, "type" | "x" | "y" | "customData">>,
448	): T => {
449	  const base: Pick<T, keyof ExcalidrawElement> = {
450	    type: extra.type || element.type,
451	    // all elements must have version > 0 so getSceneVersion() will pick up
452	    // newly added elements
453	    version: element.version || 1,
454	    versionNonce: element.versionNonce ?? 0,
455	    index: element.index ?? null,
456	    isDeleted: element.isDeleted ?? false,
457	    id: element.id || randomId(),
458	    fillStyle: element.fillStyle || DEFAULT_ELEMENT_PROPS.fillStyle,
459	    strokeWidth: element.strokeWidth || DEFAULT_ELEMENT_PROPS.strokeWidth,
460	    strokeStyle: element.strokeStyle ?? DEFAULT_ELEMENT_PROPS.strokeStyle,
461	    roughness: element.roughness ?? DEFAULT_ELEMENT_PROPS.roughness,
462	    opacity:
463	      element.opacity == null ? DEFAULT_ELEMENT_PROPS.opacity : element.opacity,
464	    angle: element.angle || (0 as Radians),
465	    x: extra.x ?? element.x ?? 0,
466	    y: extra.y ?? element.y ?? 0,
467	    strokeColor: element.strokeColor || DEFAULT_ELEMENT_PROPS.strokeColor,
468	    backgroundColor:
469	      element.backgroundColor || DEFAULT_ELEMENT_PROPS.backgroundColor,
470	    width: element.width || 0,
471	    height: element.height || 0,
472	    seed: element.seed ?? 1,
473	    groupIds: element.groupIds ?? [],
474	    frameId: element.frameId ?? null,
475	    roundness: element.roundness
476	      ? element.roundness
477	      : element.strokeSharpness === "round"
478	      ? {
479	          // for old elements that would now use adaptive radius algo,
480	          // use legacy algo instead
481	          type: isUsingAdaptiveRadius(element.type)
482	            ? ROUNDNESS.LEGACY
483	            : ROUNDNESS.PROPORTIONAL_RADIUS,
484	        }
485	      : null,
486	    boundElements: element.boundElementIds
487	      ? element.boundElementIds.map((id) => ({ type: "arrow", id }))
488	      : element.boundElements ?? [],
489	    updated: element.updated ?? getUpdatedTimestamp(),
490	    created: element.created ?? null,
491	    link: element.link ? normalizeLink(element.link) : null,
492	    locked: element.locked ?? false,
493	  };
494	
495	  if ("customData" in element || "customData" in extra) {
496	    base.customData =
497	      "customData" in extra ? extra.customData : element.customData;
498	  }
499	
500	  const ret = {
